summary: Pony AI Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the inclusion of its Hong Kong-listed Class A ordinary shares in the Shanghai-Hong Kong Stock Connect program, effective June 4, 2026. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change is involved. The inclusion expands investor access and liquidity but is a routine stock connect eligibility event, not a special situation. No deal terms apply; the filing is a standard foreign private issuer report.
